verdict.rationale: IndusLaw publishes public, open-access legal content touching startup formation, financing, and equity — e.g. the 2026 Startup Notification analysis (recognition timelines, turnover thresholds, deep-tech pathway) and the ESOP/stock-option tax publication — plus practice pages on funds, PE, and M&A that reference startups as clients. However, this is presented as law-firm publications/practice-area pages rather than a dedicated plain-language 'startup knowledge base' with FAQs or founder-oriented explainers, and there is no evidence of an organized hub structured for founders. Missing for 10: a labeled startup-specific knowledge hub, FAQ-style content, and plain-language explainer format distinct from legal publications/practice pages.
